assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Polyworld Gota modular 3D character modeling reference.
Input image is a reference only: extract the crown worn by Hades, the RIGHT character. Generate a clean isolated crown asset sheet with two equal columns labeled FRONT and BACK, orthographic views of the exact same object at the same scale on light neutral gray.
Crown: charcoal-black low-poly circlet, five tall narrow angular spires across the visible front silhouette, tallest central spear-shaped spire, descending spires to each side, broad faceted angular brow band. Central emerald green elongated diamond crystal in a thick simple gold diamond socket. Two smaller gold angular ornaments flanking it. Follow the Hades crown shape, proportions, and palette closely. Rear view must reveal a wearable open ring with a curved band and the rear of the same spires, no duplicate front jewel on the back.
Style: simple solid-color low-poly geometry with bevelled edges, smoothly rounded ring where needed; broad clean planar facets, no surface textures, no painted detail, no scratches, no excessive microgeometry. Clean soft studio light and minimal contact shadows. Generous spacing and every spire fully in frame.
Only crown, no head, no hair, no body, no eyes, no mannequin, no weapons, no hands, no character.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Polyworld Gota modular 3D hair and beard modeling reference.
Input image is a reference only: Hades is the RIGHT character. Create an isolated asset modeling sheet for his dark swept hair and short pointed beard. Four clean object views in a 2-by-2 layout, columns FRONT and BACK: top row the hair shell alone; bottom row the beard and mustache shell alone. Light neutral gray background. Exact front/rear orthographic views, same object and scale per row, fully visible and well separated.
Hair: charcoal black and dark gray solid colors, low-poly broad swept chunky locks curling outward from the temples and down to neck length; taller swept-back layered clumps over the crown, broad open face cavity with angular widow's-peak edge, long sideburn locks; large purposeful faceted clumps not many thin strands. Crown is removed to reveal hair. Match the Hades character in the reference.
Beard: short full dark pointed beard with broad angular side cheeks and a single main tapered central chin tuft; thick matching mustache above the open mouth gap, mustache tapered outward to join beard sides; simple modular wearable facial hair shell. Rear shows hollow face-facing interior only, NOT a second face.
Style: clean simple low-poly 3D, solid-color geometry with subtle bevels and smoothly flowing silhouette, matte material, studio lighting, no textures or painted strands.
No crown, skin, head, face, eyes, eyebrows, mouth anatomy, body, mannequin, hands, clothes, or weapons. Only two separate wearable geometry assets shown front/back.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Polyworld Gota Hades modular equipment modeling reference.
Input image is a design reference: Hades is the RIGHT character. Create a clean front-and-back orthographic equipment sheet on a flat LIGHT gray background: two columns labeled FRONT and BACK. Each column shows the same upright full bident staff and a separate floating emerald magic orb to its left. No characters.
Bident: long straight charcoal-black simple polygonal shaft, two tall sharp black prongs only (not three), each prong tipped with a small elongated brilliant emerald green crystal. A heavy central angular black fork joins the prongs, with a large green diamond jewel in a simple gold four-point diamond frame at the junction. Narrow gold geometric collars and small green diamond inset midway down shaft and near the pointed black bottom. Faithful to the Hades reference equipment. Front and back identical basic silhouette and dimensions; gold settings have real thickness; avoid ornate filigree and extra prongs.
Orb: a palm-sized green pointed faceted ovoid crystal, with three or four small floating emerald shards around it, optional restrained transparent green flame wisps that leave geometry clearly visible. This is separate from the bident.
Style: low-poly smooth but simple solid-color game geometry, no texture maps, no scratches, no engraved fine details, no noisy materials. Soft bright even studio illumination, mostly matte dark surfaces so silhouette remains legible, slightly emissive green crystals without large bloom. Entire staff fully visible with margins, clean spacing.
No head, body, rig, eyes, hands, mannequin, clothing, skull, sword, lightning, or Zeus.
